title: Air Fryer Naan
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour (or a 1:1 mix of all-purpose and whole wheat)
Oil, for brushing the basket or naan
Optional toppings: minced garlic, melted butter or ghee, and chopped cilantro
instructions: Mix the dough: In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the yogurt and gradually add water until a soft dough forms.
Knead and rest: Knead the dough on a floured surface for 3 to 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and let it rest for 20 to 30 minutes.
Shape the naan: Divide the dough into 4 to 6 equal pieces. Roll or stretch each piece into an oval or teardrop shape (about 1/4-inch thick).
Preheat the air fryer: Preheat to 380°F to 400°F (190°C-200°C) for 3 to 5 minutes.
Air fry: Lightly brush the air fryer basket or the naan with oil. Place the naan inside and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, flipping halfway through, until puffed and lightly charred on the edges.
Top (optional): Brush with melted butter or ghee and sprinkle with minced garlic and chopped cilantro.
notes: Makes 4 to 6 naan; nutrition is an estimate per naan (1 of 6) using all-purpose flour and regular yogurt, without optional toppings or oil for brushing.
